result.summary: This PR adds a Misbehaving call when PartiallyDownloadedBlock::InitData returns READ_STATUS_INVALID during the optimistic compact block reconstruction path, mirroring the treatment already given to malformed compact blocks in the primary handling path. It removes a TODO comment left in an earlier commit and adds a functional test exercising the new disconnect behavior when a fourth peer sends an invalid compact block after all inflight reconstruction slots are taken.
result.problem: Previously, a peer sending malformed data through the optimistic compact block reconstruction path was silently ignored rather than penalized, unlike the primary compact block path which already misbehaves on such invalid data. This is an inconsistency that node operators and the DoS-resistance model implicitly rely on being uniform.
